title: deps-status is blind to node import failure, so the boot repair never fires
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-672 - Issue #2: a silent curated-deps failure ships a broken engine and the log can never reach us (2026-09-01). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-672/plan.md. checkUniversalWorkflowDepsStatus checks folder presence + commit marker only. A pack that is present but failed to import reads as healthy for ever, so the state survives every restart. Make the health check import-aware and the repair reachable.
